status: costed design only; no accelerator implemented or hybrid proof verified

hotspot.entry_count_caveat: Entry-PC hits are measured; ABI replacement must establish exactly one permutation per entry rather than infer semantics from symbol names.
hotspot.ranking: Keccak permutation first; k256 next. Symbol-token totals are not inclusive call-graph attribution.
hotspot.idealized_caveat: Excludes replacement wrapper/ECALL work and is not a feasible proof-size or speed prediction; residual CPU clock/domain hard bounds still require a plan.

existing_compact_keccak.reuse: Consume existing direct evaluator, lookup plan, witness authority and fixed-table schemas; do not copy the RV32 orchestration stack.

flat_all_calls_counterfactual.excluded: PCS coefficients, LDEs, Merkle trees, quotient FFT scratch, opening buffers, CPU/ROM/RAM providers, caller changes, witness tapes and allocator overhead.
flat_all_calls_counterfactual.admission: log19 exceeds existing log18 admission. Splitting into two admitted log18 components gives the same aggregate base-domain cell count here; neither option is qualified RV64 acceleration.

existing_compact_keccak.decision: Do not flatten all calls into the existing width or extrapolate isolated provider timing. Model complete simultaneous lifetimes per proof batch before selecting the call ABI and provider layout.

first_accelerator_plan.candidate: One versioned in-place Keccak-f[1600] permutation service using standard ECALL in a rebuilt, identity-bound RV64 guest.
first_accelerator_plan.scope: Keep absorb, padding and squeeze in software first; replace only the audited permutation leaf after complete cost modeling.
forbidden_shortcuts: No custom opcode or host-oracle result authority.
No hot-PC software-body skipping without an admitted equivalence contract.
No automatic activation of an unqualified Word16/narrow-layout candidate.
No wide per-call CPU witness or duplicated input/output bit decomposition.
No thousands of wrapped caller/provider proofs.
first_accelerator_plan.dynamic_call_binding: Authenticate service/version, call ID, CPU retirement clock, PC and 64-bit register pointer through a typed call relation. Exact call multiplicity closes with the provider caller; software logs alone are not authority.
first_accelerator_plan.ram_binding: Provider-side caller consumes 25 aligned eight-byte cells for the 200-byte in-place state, reusing provider state bits as bytes. Bind every address, prior clock, before value and after value to the shared RV64 RAM relation; prove alignment, span/no-wrap, access permission and clock ranges. Distinct cells may share the admitted ECALL memory phase. Specify partial-overlap behavior before generalizing the ABI.
first_accelerator_plan.execution_binding: Prove ECALL decode, next PC, allowed register writes and all untouched register/state transitions. This requires new RV64 AIR/caller integration; existing full software proofs do not provide it.
first_accelerator_plan.proof_shape: CPU, ROM, crypto and tables retain independently sized domains. One global PCS/FRI transaction per selected proof batch, with shared typed relation closure and correctly lifted component domains/masks/quotient denominators.
first_accelerator_plan.transcript: Bind program and ABI identity, admitted component roster/degrees/domains and counts; seal all fixed/main roots including table multiplicities before lookup challenges; bind claims before interaction commitment; independently derive fixed roots and close all typed/RAM/register claims against public boundaries.
cost_model_required: Residual CPU retirements and clock/domain limits after wrapper lowering.
Per-family live/padded rows, columns, lookup batches, degree and table counts.
Peak simultaneous trace/coefficient/LDE/Merkle/quotient/opening storage and shared scratch reuse.
RAM caller bytes/clocks and ABI adapter overhead, without counting duplicated buffers as free.
Measured end-to-end witness, commitments, interaction, quotient and fresh verification costs on representative proof batches.
If multiple execution batches are necessary, authenticated state continuity and whole-block composition must be designed explicitly; no full-block proof claim follows from batch execution.

other_providers.secp256k1: Reuse existing independently sized product, linear, point, split, scalar, signed-table, ECDSA, recovery and byte families through their shared polynomial authority. Existing recovery is successful-only: invalid scalar/recovery cases must remain software or receive separately proved failure semantics. RV32 custom0 runner, pointers and RAM caller are not reusable unchanged.
other_providers.sha256: Packed source/schedule/round/feed-forward geometry exists (88/48/64/8 rows per compression), but packed arithmetic/call sources explicitly mark production_active=false. Requires caller/RAM closure and receiver/adversarial qualification before activation; no priority over measured Keccak hotspot.

qualification_gates: Preserve the current software receipt as control; identical block input must retain all 43 output bytes after guest lowering.
Establish permutation entry/call semantics and compare complete input/output states, including empty messages, sponge boundaries and multi-permutation messages.
Small one-call, repeated-call and unequal-domain proofs: serialize, destroy producer state, and independently reconstruct setup/verify.
Reject service/version, call-ID, PC, pointer, input/output byte, prior-clock and terminal-clock mutations.
Reject missing, duplicated, reordered or cross-call-swapped calls and altered multiplicities/claims.
Reject address truncation, alignment/span overflow, readonly writes and illegal overlap; verify shared RAM boundary continuity.
Reject altered program/ABI identities, component geometry/degrees/table roots and transcript order.
Exercise arbitrary QM31 OODS values and previous-row masks, not only honest witness rows; retain shared evaluator authority.
Measure complete proof-batch peak memory and end-to-end verified throughput before promoting any layout or ABI; full-block hybrid proof remains unimplemented.
